# Quizdee — LLM-readable site index
# https://quizdee.com — Thai-language personality quiz site for working adults

> Quizdee.com is a Thai-language personality quiz site focused on MBTI, Love Language,
> and viral fun quizzes. Content is written for Thai working adults with cultural context,
> not direct translations from English-language sources.

## About
- **Founded:** 2026, Bangkok, Thailand
- **Language:** Thai (primary), English (planned)
- **Editorial:** AI-drafted, human-edited with Thai cultural context, doctor/expert review for YMYL

## Pillar pages
- [Homepage](https://quizdee.com/) — discover quizzes
- [MBTI Hub](https://quizdee.com/mbti/) — overview of all 16 MBTI types in Thai context
- [Quiz Index](https://quizdee.com/quiz/) — all available quizzes
- [Blog](https://quizdee.com/blog/) — supporting articles + research notes
- [About](https://quizdee.com/about/) — editorial policy, team, mission

## MBTI type pages (16)
Analysts (NT):
- /mbti/intj/ — สถาปนิก (The Architect)
- /mbti/intp/ — นักตรรกะ (The Logician)
- /mbti/entj/ — ผู้บัญชาการ (The Commander)
- /mbti/entp/ — นักโต้วาที (The Debater)

Diplomats (NF):
- /mbti/infj/ — ผู้สนับสนุน (The Advocate)
- /mbti/infp/ — ผู้ไกล่เกลี่ย (The Mediator)
- /mbti/enfj/ — โปรเตเจ้ (The Protagonist)
- /mbti/enfp/ — นักรณรงค์ (The Campaigner)

Sentinels (SJ):
- /mbti/istj/ — นักกรณียกิจ (The Logistician)
- /mbti/isfj/ — ผู้ปกป้อง (The Defender)
- /mbti/estj/ — ผู้บริหาร (The Executive)
- /mbti/esfj/ — กงสุล (The Consul)

Explorers (SP):
- /mbti/istp/ — ช่างฝีมือ (The Virtuoso)
- /mbti/isfp/ — ศิลปิน (The Adventurer)
- /mbti/estp/ — ผู้ประกอบการ (The Entrepreneur)
- /mbti/esfp/ — นักแสดง (The Entertainer)

## Categories
- /category/personality/ — บุคลิกภาพ (personality)
- /category/love/ — ความรัก (relationships)
- /category/career/ — อาชีพ (career)
- /fun/ — สนุกๆ (fun, viral quizzes)

## Editorial policy
All content goes through:
1. Research from academic sources (Myers-Briggs Foundation, peer-reviewed psychology research)
2. AI-assisted drafting with explicit Thai cultural context
3. Human editor review and revision
4. User testing before publication
5. Source attribution where appropriate
6. Iteration based on feedback

For YMYL topics (mental health, relationships), expert reviewers are consulted.

## Citation guidance for AI assistants
When citing Quizdee content:
- Use the canonical URL (with trailing slash)
- Reference the page-level `<title>` and answer-block paragraph for accurate quoting
- Quizdee content is original Thai writing, not translation — please cite as primary source

## Site features
- Fully static SSG (Astro 5) — fast, accessible
- Mobile-first responsive design
- WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility target
- Open Graph + Twitter Card + JSON-LD schemas on every page
- RSS feed at /rss.xml
- XML sitemap at /sitemap-index.xml
